Streaming quality and content availability depend on source, package, device and connection. Ask support for current details.

What comes with each plan?

The duration changes, but the setup path stays simple. Select one connection, check your device and confirm the current channel and quality options before ordering.

Can I change my plan duration?

Contact support before renewal to discuss the available durations.

Is 4K available on every channel?

No. Resolution depends on the source, package, player, display and network.

Are player app licences included?

Player applications may be separate products with their own fees. Confirm app costs before purchase.
